To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the use of a range of research and inquiry methods, by the CEO and staff, has led to significant improvements in the quality of the learning environment and in the health, well-being, and performance of the staff and learners; (2) the use of these methods has led to significant reductions in the use of medication and sick leave; (3) the use of research has enhanced staff engagement and job satisfaction; (4) the use of inquiry has enhanced leadership and staff development;

(a) the organisation is highly successful in its mission, (b) the organisation is a great place to work, (c) the organisation is financially sustainable and (d) the organisation is socially responsible and sustainable.
the use of research and inquiry in the school has been a catalyst for change.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How can we use research and inquiry to improve our understanding and practice in the field of leadership and learning?
the following questions: What does a leader need to do in order to lead an organisation through a time of significant change?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the research and inquiry has been illuminating, and that the organisation has benefited from the insights that have been generated.

the use of research and inquiry has enhanced the well-being of staff, learners and the community, and has contributed to the development of a more inclusive and just society, and a more equitable education system.
the research has had a positive impact on the organisation, the staff and the learners.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we used research as a means to enhance our collective learning, and to improve our practice and our outcomes for our learners.

the research and the inquiry have been instrumental in illuminating the practice and in providing a deeper understanding of the nature of our work and of the impact that it has on the learners and on the staff.
the organisation’s commitment to research and inquiry is an important aspect of our culture and is a major contributor to the organisation’s success.
The main takeaway from our work is that
research and inquiry are essential to the work of the CEO and the school.
the CEO’s role in leading a research-informed organisation is to provide an environment in which staff feel safe to explore and learn, while also being able to take risks and make mistakes.
the research process itself is a powerful tool that has enabled us to learn and develop as an organisation, and that it is a process that is accessible to any organisation.
